findings.detail: Second consecutive guaranteed-slot tick where the launchd firer invoked the slot before the cowork dispatcher reached Step 5. chef-eod 08:47:24Z (tick 08:45), fb-daily 09:15:07Z (tick 09:15). Caught both times ONLY by the ad-hoc `ps -eo pid,etime,command | grep slot=<id>` probe; PID 54369 was 58s in-flight at probe time. Step 4b cannot see this — it groups by agent_id WITHIN one MATCHES array, and this is cross-MECHANISM. Two-for-two is not a coincidence window: both mechanisms compute the same cron, so they collide on EVERY guaranteed slot whose cron the dispatcher also matches. Needs a real guard, not a router habit.
